listing.name: Dr. Mario NES Recomp
listing.summary: Play Dr. Mario with the official Windows runtime and your matching original NES ROM.

steps.title: Choose the Windows package that matches your original
steps.instruction: Use the official USA Windows x64 ZIP with your Japan/USA Rev 1 original for the Portcove registration route. For an original European ROM, use the official EU Windows x64 ZIP and its upstream player.

steps.title: Set up the Windows player
steps.instruction: Extract the full ZIP with its DLLs and assets. Open DrMarioRecomp.exe from that folder and select your own matching original. Keep the USA NTSC and European PAL copies and their profiles separate.

steps.title: Register your prepared USA copy
steps.instruction: After setup, close the player. In Portcove select DrMarioRecomp.exe and its extracted folder. Add the original ROM’s full path as one argument line without quotes. If you leave the argument empty, keep the upstream launcher enabled.

steps.title: Build the Linux player from upstream source
steps.instruction: On Linux x86-64, use the upstream source and its pinned submodules, CMake, a native C/C++ toolchain and system SDL2 development files. Set SDL2_DIR to the system SDL2 CMake package and NESRECOMP_ROM to your matching original. Set DRMARIO_REGION to usa or eu and use separate build folders. Launch the result through the upstream instructions.

steps.title: Keep your player data
steps.instruction: Back up the actual settings and saves with the game closed before updating the upstream player. Keep cycle save states with their creating build and region. Removing a Portcove registration leaves the player, original and profile in place.

warnings: The existing Portcove registration observation covers the USA Windows package. The European package and Linux source build are upstream setup.

references.title: Reviewed Windows packages and Linux source evidence
references.instruction: See https://github.com/mstan/DrMarioNesRecomp/releases/tag/v1.3.1 for the separate USA and European packages and the upstream Linux system SDL2 instructions.

presentation.manual_preparation: Download the official USA Windows x64 ZIP from upstream Releases and extract the entire archive, including its DLLs and assets. Run DrMarioRecomp.exe, use Browse For ROM to select your own matching Dr. Mario (Japan, USA) Rev 1 NES ROM, then Play and close normally. The European package needs its matching European original and is not covered by this USA check. Return to Portcove, choose DrMarioRecomp.exe and its extracted folder as the working directory, add the original ROM's full path as one argument, and review the launch details before registering. In Desktop, enter that path on one line without surrounding quotes. Leaving arguments empty requires upstream's launcher to remain enabled. You or upstream handle runtime updates. Remove registration only forgets Portcove's reference; the runtime, original, saves and settings stay in place. Existing Portcove-built installations retain their original contracts.
